5. Concretely: what is the SMALLEST change to our existing CN=48/STAGES=3/CM=128 persist mainloop that would most raise tensor utilization toward FA3's, given we CANNOT widen CN (smem-capped) and CANNOT use 2 stages (starves)? Return the schema; concrete_steps should be the ranked list of portable changes to our kernel.

933	    load_tail(MainloopPipelineK pipeline_k, MainloopPipelineV pipeline_v, MainloopPipelineVt pipeline_vt,
934	              PipelineState& smem_pipe_write, SharedStorage &shared_storage, int const work_idx) {
935	        // If we don't wait for barrier_O here, when using Cluster, CTA0 might exit early and CTA1 will

937	        shared_storage.pipelines.barrier_O.wait((work_idx + 1) % 2);

941	        if (warp_idx_in_warpgroup == 0 && cute::elect_one_sync()) {
942	            /* This helps avoid early exit of blocks in Cluster

944	            *  then would just be acquired since the phase was still inverted from make_producer_start_state
